item.text: {"summary":"The draft is mostly publishable, but it needs tighter support for the release-date rule and interval derivation before publication.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"warning","summary":"The resolver and first-print rule are clear, but the draft asserts the 2026-07-10 posting date without quoting or identifying the exact calendar entry name/date from the cited release calendar.","actionRequested":"Add the exact USDA FNS release-calendar entry used to verify that the March 2026 SNAP data first print is scheduled for 2026-07-10."},{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"warning","summary":"The draft states a persistence/base-rate prior but does not clearly say whether a time-series model was used or ruled out.","actionRequested":"Add one sentence explicitly ruling out a formal time-series model, or state the simple persistence/trend model used and why it is adequate."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The 80% interval is plausible but not tied to a measured realized volatility, revision error, or explicit uncertainty calculation.","actionRequested":"Explain the interval width using recent month-to-month variation, historical first-print misses/revisions, or a named judgmental uncertainty assumption."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The +0.20 million macro/need adjustment and -0.03 to -0.05 million policy adjustment are directionally explained but weakly evidenced from the cited public sources.","actionRequested":"Either cite concrete public evidence for these adjustment sizes from the cited materials or label them explicitly as judgmental adjustments."},{"rubricItem":"coherence","severity":"warning","summary":"The drivers mention a -0.05 million policy drag, while the math uses -0.03 million.","actionRequested":"Make the policy/churn adjustment numerically consistent across the reasoning and point calculation."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify whether historicalContext values are first-print values or latest visible official values.","State that the unit conversion is from persons to millions for all displayed historical points as well as the final resolved value."]}
